---
title: "AI Career Coach Chatbot"
subtitle: "Interactive career guidance for graduate students"
description: "Answer career-development questions and get a personalized, AI-style coaching response with next-step recommendations."
order: 6
---

This interactive page helps graduate students think through career decisions by turning your answers into a personalized coaching conversation powered by a local Llama 3.2 language model.

---

## Career Development Chatbot

> **Runs entirely in your browser.** This page uses [WebLLM](https://webllm.mlc.ai/) to run Llama 3.2 (1 B) locally via WebGPU — no data ever leaves your device and no external AI service is called. **Requires Chrome 113+ or Edge 113+** with WebGPU enabled. The model (~700 MB) is downloaded and cached on first use.

```{=html}
<section class="career-coach-shell">
  <form id="career-coach-form" class="career-coach-form">
    <label>Career direction
      <select id="cc-track" required>
        <option value="">Choose one</option>
        <option value="academia">Academia (faculty/research)</option>
        <option value="industry">Industry (R&D/product/data)</option>
        <option value="government">Government/public sector</option>
        <option value="nonprofit">Nonprofit/policy/advocacy</option>
        <option value="undecided">Undecided/exploring</option>
      </select>
    </label>

    <label>Job search timeline
      <select id="cc-timeline" required>
        <option value="">Choose one</option>
        <option value="0-3">0–3 months</option>
        <option value="3-6">3–6 months</option>
        <option value="6-12">6–12 months</option>
        <option value="12+">12+ months</option>
      </select>
    </label>

    <label>Preferred work style
      <select id="cc-style" required>
        <option value="">Choose one</option>
        <option value="independent">Independent deep work</option>
        <option value="collaborative">Highly collaborative teamwork</option>
        <option value="hybrid">Hybrid balance</option>
      </select>
    </label>

    <label>Top strength
      <input id="cc-strength" type="text" maxlength="120" placeholder="e.g., experimental design, coding, communication" required />
    </label>

    <label>Main concern
      <textarea id="cc-concern" rows="3" maxlength="240" placeholder="e.g., not enough publications, unclear resume translation" required></textarea>
    </label>

    <fieldset>
      <legend>Top priorities (choose up to 3)</legend>
      <label><input type="checkbox" name="cc-priority" value="salary" /> Salary growth</label>
      <label><input type="checkbox" name="cc-priority" value="impact" /> Social/scientific impact</label>
      <label><input type="checkbox" name="cc-priority" value="stability" /> Long-term stability</label>
      <label><input type="checkbox" name="cc-priority" value="flexibility" /> Work-life flexibility</label>
      <label><input type="checkbox" name="cc-priority" value="mentorship" /> Mentorship and learning</label>
    </fieldset>

    <button type="submit" id="cc-submit" disabled>Generate coaching response</button>
  </form>

  <div id="career-llm-status" class="career-llm-status" aria-live="polite"></div>

  <div id="career-chat" class="career-chat" role="log" aria-relevant="additions" aria-label="Career coach chat transcript">
    <div class="chat-message chat-message--coach">Loading Llama 3.2 model… this may take a moment on first visit.</div>
  </div>

  <form id="career-followup-form" class="career-followup" hidden>
    <label for="cc-followup">Ask a follow-up question</label>
    <input id="cc-followup" type="text" maxlength="220" placeholder="e.g., How should I prepare for industry interviews?" />
    <button type="submit">Send</button>
  </form>
</section>

<script type="module">
(async () => {
  const root = document.querySelector(".career-coach-shell");
  if (!root) return;

  const form       = root.querySelector("#career-coach-form");
  const submitBtn  = root.querySelector("#cc-submit");
  const chat       = root.querySelector("#career-chat");
  const statusEl   = root.querySelector("#career-llm-status");
  const followupForm  = root.querySelector("#career-followup-form");
  const followupInput = root.querySelector("#cc-followup");

  const clean = (v) => String(v || "").trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ");

  const setStatus = (msg) => { statusEl.textContent = msg; };

  const addMessage = (role, text) => {
    const bubble = document.createElement("div");
    bubble.className = `chat-message chat-message--${role}`;
    bubble.textContent = text;
    chat.appendChild(bubble);
    chat.scrollTop = chat.scrollHeight;
  };

  // Replace placeholder greeting once we start loading
  chat.querySelector(".chat-message--coach").textContent =
    "Initializing Llama 3.2 1B — please wait…";

  // ── WebGPU check ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!navigator.gpu) {
    const msg = "WebGPU is not available in this browser. Please open this page in Chrome 113+, Edge 113+, or another WebGPU-enabled browser to run the local Llama model.";
    chat.querySelector(".chat-message--coach").textContent = msg;
    setStatus("⚠️ WebGPU required.");
    return;
  }

  // ── Load WebLLM from CDN ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  let webllm;
  try {
    webllm = await import("https://esm.run/@mlc-ai/web-llm");
  } catch (err) {
    const msg = "Could not load the WebLLM library. Check your internet connection and reload the page.";
    chat.querySelector(".chat-message--coach").textContent = msg;
    setStatus(`⚠️ Library load failed: ${err.message}`);
    return;
  }

  // ── Initialise engine with Llama 3.2 1B ─────────────────────────────────
  const MODEL_ID = "Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-q4f32_1-MLC";
  let engine;

  setStatus("Downloading Llama 3.2 1B (~700 MB, cached after first visit)…");
  try {
    engine = await webllm.CreateMLCEngine(MODEL_ID, {
      initProgressCallback: ({ progress, text }) => {
        const pct = Math.round((progress || 0) * 100);
        setStatus(`Loading Llama 3.2 1B… ${text || pct + "%"}`);
      }
    });
  } catch (err) {
    chat.querySelector(".chat-message--coach").textContent =
      "Model failed to load. See the status bar for details.";
    setStatus(`⚠️ Model load error: ${err.message}`);
    return;
  }

  // Model ready
  setStatus("Llama 3.2 1B ready.");
  chat.querySelector(".chat-message--coach").textContent =
    "Hi! Share your profile in the form and I'll generate a coaching plan tailored to your graduate-school goals.";
  submitBtn.disabled = false;
  setTimeout(() => { statusEl.textContent = ""; }, 4000);

  // ── Conversation history (system + turns) ────────────────────────────────
  const SYSTEM_PROMPT =
    "You are an expert career coach for PhD graduate students. " +
    "Give concise, specific, and actionable advice. " +
    "Keep each response to 4–6 sentences unless more detail is requested. " +
    "Focus on practical next steps. Be encouraging but realistic.";

  const history = [];

  const chat_with_llm = async (userMessage) => {
    history.push({ role: "user", content: userMessage });
    const reply = await engine.chat.completions.create({
      messages: [{ role: "system", content: SYSTEM_PROMPT }, ...history],
      temperature: 0.7,
      max_tokens: 350
    });
    const text = reply.choices[0].message.content.trim();
    history.push({ role: "assistant", content: text });
    return text;
  };

  // ── Form submit ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  form.addEventListener("submit", async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();

    const checked = [...root.querySelectorAll('input[name="cc-priority"]:checked')];
    if (checked.length > 3) {
      alert("Please select at most 3 priorities.");
      return;
    }

    const priorities = checked.map((el) => el.parentElement.textContent.trim());
    const profile = {
      track:    clean(root.querySelector("#cc-track").value),
      timeline: clean(root.querySelector("#cc-timeline").value),
      style:    clean(root.querySelector("#cc-style").value),
      strength: clean(root.querySelector("#cc-strength").value),
      concern:  clean(root.querySelector("#cc-concern").value),
      priorities
    };

    if (!profile.track || !profile.timeline || !profile.style ||
        !profile.strength || !profile.concern) return;

    const userMsg =
      `My career profile: target sector = ${profile.track}; ` +
      `timeline = ${profile.timeline} months; ` +
      `preferred work style = ${profile.style}; ` +
      `top strength = "${profile.strength}"; ` +
      `main concern = "${profile.concern}"; ` +
      `priorities = ${priorities.length ? priorities.join(", ") : "general career clarity"}. ` +
      "Please provide a personalized coaching plan with concrete next steps for the next two weeks.";

    addMessage("user",
      `Career track: ${profile.track} | Timeline: ${profile.timeline} months | Concern: ${profile.concern}`);

    submitBtn.disabled = true;
    submitBtn.textContent = "Generating…";
    setStatus("Llama 3.2 is thinking…");

    try {
      const response = await chat_with_llm(userMsg);
      addMessage("coach", response);
      followupForm.hidden = false;
    } catch (err) {
      addMessage("coach", "Sorry, there was an error generating your coaching plan. Please try again.");
      setStatus(`⚠️ Generation error: ${err.message}`);
    } finally {
      submitBtn.disabled = false;
      submitBtn.textContent = "Generate coaching response";
      setTimeout(() => { statusEl.textContent = ""; }, 3000);
    }
  });

  // ── Follow-up submit ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  followupForm.addEventListener("submit", async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const question = clean(followupInput.value);
    if (!question) return;

    addMessage("user", question);
    followupInput.value = "";

    const sendBtn = followupForm.querySelector("button[type=submit]");
    sendBtn.disabled = true;
    sendBtn.textContent = "Thinking…";
    setStatus("Llama 3.2 is thinking…");

    try {
      const response = await chat_with_llm(question);
      addMessage("coach", response);
    } catch (err) {
      addMessage("coach", "Sorry, I couldn't process that question. Please try again.");
      setStatus(`⚠️ Generation error: ${err.message}`);
    } finally {
      sendBtn.disabled = false;
      sendBtn.textContent = "Send";
      followupInput.focus();
      setTimeout(() => { statusEl.textContent = ""; }, 3000);
    }
  });
})();
</script>
```

---

### Suggested ways to use this page

- Re-run the coach after updating your priorities each semester.
- Use the generated steps as an agenda for advisor or mentor meetings.
- Convert one coaching recommendation into a measurable weekly deliverable.
